lines.1: 「I know it was for the job, but I guess I got a little carried away... Sorry.」
lines.2: 「See that it does not happen again. This could easily become a matter for the student council.」
lines.5: For some reason, Fukahire looked delighted.
lines.6: 「This method's inefficient. We're just giving ourselves a bad reputation.」
lines.7: 「Let's head back to headquarters for now.」
